newsitem.title: ITALY: No pick-up in Italian economy seen in H1 - Fossa.
newsitem.headline: No pick-up in Italian economy seen in H1 - Fossa.

text.p: There will be no major pick-up in the Italian economy in the first half of 1997, the head of employers' federation, the Confindustria, said.
"I don't see any recovery in the short-term. We will have to wait until at least the middle of 1997 before seeing any major signs of a recovery," Giorgio Fossa told reporters.
"We're worried about stagnating output, the weakness of domestic demand and investments, unemployment levels and the climate of general uncertainty," Fossa added.
Figures released earlier this week showed gross domestic product rising by a real 0.7 percent, year-on-year, in the third quarter of 1996. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
